purpose: Shared illustrative scenes for fictional artist journals; not documentary evidence.

prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fictional artist journal image for a quiet independent music listening app. Make one square 1024x1024 candid 35mm film photograph of an empty small home recording studio at dusk. Close view of an old upright piano, compact tape recorder, headphones and handwritten notebook with indistinct writing, warm window light falling across worn wood, charcoal shadows, fine natural grain. Intimate, real, understated editorial photography. No people, logos, watermarks, legible text, UI or collage.
